author: val
body: MC146818 spec, not our design. Status B bit 7 (SET) freezes the update cycle and must be raised before writing any time register and lowered afterwards, or the part can update between two writes and carry a half-written time forward. Status B bit 2 chooses binary over BCD and bit 1 24-hour over 12-hour; both belong to the PART, so every value is encoded the way the part declares. In 12-hour mode the hour register carries 1..12 with bit 7 meaning PM, and midnight is 12 AM. Register 9 is a two-digit year; the century register is not reliably present, so the year is 2000 plus that value.

author: val
body: Zone and stripe offsets are stored plus twelve because `peek-32` zero-extends: a stored -5 reads back as a large positive.

author: val
body: The whole write sits inside one SET window; nothing between raising and lowering the bit may fail or return early, which is why the values come from the state block rather than being computed here.
